policy.liturgical: 1962 original calendar remains principal; supplementary canonisations/Doctors/collective martyrs are secondary and never silently substitute old Mass rites.
policy.collectives: One collective entry for martyr group; do not expand hundreds of members as individual art requirements.
policy.uniqueness: Deduplicate exact canonical IDs only. Do not assert that two different labels or IDs are identical without Saints/Calendar owner crosswalk.
policy.media: An aesthetic score five is not a verified physical original or usable production image. No artwork release without exact-photo-to-original/crop/rights checks.
policy.noninvasive: Reference-only aggregate, no mutation of canonical Saints, Calendar, Mass, or existing Sacred Art rating libraries.

unresolvedGates: Resolve historical distinct-person/collective identities and canonical aliases across owners; 600 is exact-ID union, not a final unique saint count.
Return a certified legacy-art 75-subject-to-calendar canonical person/group ID crosswalk before claiming any of W72's 71 ratings cover these 600 IDs.
Determine final scope of supplementary saints: official 51 listed canonisation years are transcribed, but not a fully complete global post-1960-to-2026 calendar or liturgical date authority.
Map selective, genuinely significant collective groups once, no martyr member enumeration.
Verify source photographs, rights, physical original equivalence, mobile crops, and Calendar owner runtime release prior to publication.
Cover remaining four five-star shortlist subjects: St Mark, St Cyril of Alexandria, St Cyril of Jerusalem, St Hilary of Poitiers.
